book.title: LUK Kamambuno Wakai Luk Muno Boglkwa

content: Bugla-sipsip taya ongwa diboglkwa
Ande enge suwarata takis ingwa yomba ya tandaglme erikwa yomba Yesus kamo piramnedi pre ana prapra wu makaisi mogl winambo dingwa.
Ba Parisi wagle ya lo beke teingwa yomba ye mambuno bogl tengramo dingwa, “Yagl i tandaglme erikwa yomba di-ingo ana kaiya mokna ye bogl akiye neingwa.”
Ana Yesus ka i di simbogl ditongwa,
“Ene mina yagl ta bugla-sipsip 100 kuran meglmbi, ana suwarata taya enan, ye sragl erambe, ana ye bugla-sipsip 99 endinan pendigl meglmbi ana suwarata taya ongwa ipre ye doko pi kan ikrambo?
Ana ye kan inambuka enge, yaglmo gun pond yei bugla-sipsip ikra i komba mina pandigl.
Ana kake yend ikine yungumo pindre ana ye yeinongwa ya yomba mangigl meglkwa aglendi suwara ende ana dungwa, ‘Na buglana sipsip taya ongwa ikra kaninga pre, nono akiye gauglne gun yeinamga.’
Na ene diteinga, kuno yeglmere, tandaglme yomba suwarata nomane yake tenan, ana heven suna gun pond kaima yeitenaglkwa. Yeglpre yomba 99 du-yene meglkwa ye nomano yake tenaglkwa ta paikrukwa.
Moni mongo taya ongwa di simboglkwa
“Ambu ta moni mongo 10 kan-nongwa ba suwarata ta ipi endinan, ana ambumo i sragl erambe? Ye ken-lam gagl, yungumo wiglki kuro ana wakai ere doko pi kan inambuka.

Ana kan yungwa enge ye yomba yeinongwa ya yungu mangigl keipaingwa akiye dimakai sindre ana ditenambuka, ‘Na gun pond yeinga, na monina mongo taya ongwa ikra kaninga pre nono akiye gauglne gun yeinamga!’
Na ene diteinga, kuno yegl keunde tandaglme yomba suwarata nomane yake tenan ana God angelomo gun pond kaima yeinaglkwa.”
Yagl ta wam taya omere di simboglkwa
Yesus ka ta ama yegl dungwa, “Yagl ta moglkwa ye wam suwo miurka.
Ana wam okuwo yegl di nem tongwa, ‘Nina, na bonana yenga i erme nana i naro.’ Yegl dungo neno bona ganamo yumbusi wam suwo tongwa.
“Ana wam okuwo enge sungunagle ta mogltre taraglmo prapra moni bogl indre ana yungumo kondo ende dumo eglke ta ongwa. Igle ye monimo guagua ere sidundindre, ende are ongwa.
Ye taraglmo prapra sidundi kondungo ana okuwo makan kande igle mundu kindan pond yongo, ye taragl ta pai tekruko ana dokungwa.
Yeglpre yene oglandi ende pi dumo igle makan nem ta moglmara kongun era pre ongo ana ye bugla kuglko meglmara kaiya tendre sugl morambedi pre diendungwa.
Ana ye bugla miugla nangiye nemara i ne kau kaima sinagledi prukwa. Ba yomba taragl ye ninambuka ta tekrikwa.
“Okuwo ye pir ikine ende nomane wakai indre ana dungwa, ‘Na nina yomba mere kongunmo eraglkwa yungo ana ye kaiya mokna ne kau singwa. Ana na mangigl igle kindan gogl yono moglka.
Yeglpre na ende ikine nina moglmara pindre, ana ye ditenaglka: Nina, na tandaglme ere God tendre ana ene tendre erika.
Na yomba wakai ta moglumbo kade, ene na wana we dikratnga. Ene na i kongun eraglmedi inga yomba yeglmere endo.’
Yegl dindre ana oglandi mambuno bogl ende ikine nem moglmara ongwa. “Ba ye eglke wu pango, nem ye kandre miriye gogl, mukundi ende wam umara pi ana ongo koglkoglo puglandi wam kungro bare ere yungwa.
“Ana wam ditongwa, ‘Nina, na tandaglme ere God ya ene akiye teinga. Na wakai ta moglmbo kade ene na wana we dikratnga.’
“Ba nem di nigl kongunmo yomba tongwa, ‘Tambre pi gagl suna olto wakai i ende tendre te bomgo pesungwa i ongo mongo mina ende tendre te kagle towo i kagle mina ende teiyo!
Ana ene pindre bugla-kau nangigle wam boglkwa yundre sikembi nono gauglne gun yenamuna.
Sraglpre na wana i goglkwa ba aglke ukor ongwa, ye taya ongwa ba ye kaninga.’ Ana ye mambuno ere mokna bir neingwa.
“Enge i wam komuno kongun ere yaglmara suna wanmoglkwa ana ende yungugl unagledi mangigl undre pruko pumingsi, giglange di, katno engre meglkwa.
Pirtre nigl-kongun yomba suwarata agle dindre ana krapoglkwa, ‘I sragl erme?’
Ana nigl-kongun yomba di ikine ende tongwa, ‘Ene angitn ende ikine yungumugl ungo ana nen bugla-kau nangigle wam boglkwa sikeingwa. Sraglpre wam wau boglkura ba wakai mogl ende ikine ungwa.’
“Ba angigle komuno ye dem pond kumbruko ana ye ende yungugl enakrukwa. Yeglpre nem ende menda undre ana ye ende yungugl unambedi pre ka wakai ditongwa.
Ba ye di ikine ende nem tongwa, ‘Kano! Buglayungu merkinde na ene kongun yoko erete moglka te ene kan ta sendekrika. Ba ene bugla-meme ta natngo na yombanma bogl sikei ne gun yeikungra.
Ba ene wan i ye moninen ya bona ganan ipi guagua ere ambu kunogl gundo tekondo ana ye ende ikine ungo, ana ene kau nangigle wam boglkwa ye pre sikenga.’
“Nem di tongwa, ‘Na wana ya, ene dangir dangir na bogl motnga ana taragl kanekane yeinga i ene yenga yongwa.
Ba nono kaiya mokna ere ne ana gun yeinamga, sraglpre, ene angitn i goglkwa ba erme aglke ukor ongwa, te ye wu taya ongwa ba kan yumga.’”
